Initialization
```{r}
library(bmstdr)
data(wolfcamp, package = "geoR")

dat <- data.frame(x = wolfcamp$coords[, 1],
                  y = wolfcamp$coords[, 2],
                  z = wolfcamp$data)

set.seed(2026)
```


Comme le package bmstdr permet d'utiliser spBayes et de comparer nous allons utiliser uniquement ce package.

```{r}
bmstdr_variogram(formula = z ~ x + y, data = dat,
               coordtype = "plain")
bmstdr_variogram(formula = z ~ 1, data = dat,
               coordtype = "plain")
```



Modeling
model = spat -> fait un ajustement bayésien exact avec une covariance σ² exp(-φ d) et sans nugget.
```{r}
M1 <- Bspatial(model = "spat", formula = z ~ x + y, data = dat,
               coordtype = "utm", coords = 1:2,   # columns 1:2 of dat are x, y
               phi = 0.4, mchoice = TRUE, verbose = F)

summary(M1)
plot(M1)
```
```{r}
M2 <- Bspatial(formula=z ~ x + y, 
               data = dat,
               coordtype="utm", 
               coords=1:2, 
               prior.phi=c(0.005, 2), 
               package="spBayes",
               verbose = F)
```

```{r}
library(bmstdr)
data(wolfcamp, package = "geoR")

dat <- data.frame(x = wolfcamp$coords[, 1],
                  y = wolfcamp$coords[, 2],
                  z = wolfcamp$data)

set.seed(2026)

f    <- z ~ x + y
phi0 <- 0.02
s2   <- var(residuals(lm(f, data = dat)))   # ordre de grandeur pour b

# 1. package "none" : exact, sans nugget
m_none <- Bspatial(package = "none", model = "spat", formula = f, data = dat,
                   coordtype = "plain", coords = 1:2, phi = phi0,
                   prior.sigma2 = c(2, s2),
                   mchoice = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

# 2. spBayes : avec nugget
m_spb <- Bspatial(package = "spBayes", formula = f, data = dat,
                  coordtype = "plain", coords = 1:2, phi = phi0,
                  prior.sigma2 = c(2, s2), prior.tau2 = c(2, s2),
                  N = 5000, burn.in = 1000,
                  mchoice = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

# 3. stan : avec nugget
m_stan <- Bspatial(package = "stan", formula = f, data = dat,
                   coordtype = "plain", coords = 1:2, phi = phi0,
                   N = 5000, burn.in = 1000,
                   mchoice = TRUE, verbose = FALSE)

# Comparaison
res <- list(none = m_none, spBayes = m_spb, stan = m_stan)

for (nm in names(res)) {
  cat("\n---", nm, "---\n")
  print(res[[nm]]$params)
}

print(round(t(sapply(res, function(m) unlist(m$mchoice))), 2))
```
